purpose: Falsifiable development study, not a guarantee of profitable or independently validated performance

proxy_control.hypothesis: Unchanged v4 daily proxy control; not the strict lecture polyline

proxy_context_252.hypothesis: One-year structural context reduces arbitrary expiry of slower trend reversals while retaining frozen key breaks and same-episode permission

proxy_volume_1.hypothesis: Volume not below its past mean is sufficient; test incremental value of the empirical 1.2 cutoff without removing volume evidence

proxy_rr_1.hypothesis: A net 1:1 minimum is an alternative economic assumption; retain the actual structural stop and first unhit target, never fabricate narrower risk

promotion: none_automatic; requires independent data, full historical security metadata, annotations and additional forward observation
selection_rule: development only: eligible candidates with >=30 closed trades, >=5 traded symbols, positive mean net daily return and positive 2x-cost return; choose largest net return, name tie-break; otherwise retain CASH
limitations: Existing ten stocks and historical periods have already been inspected.
Hash-selected local files are not a historical point-in-time all-market universe.
Trial-family statistics cover only these four recorded candidates, not every historical manual experiment.
All daily candidates are proxies; strict lecture strategy remains a separately reported reference.
